apps.localizedDescription:
Legacy - Reawakening has been released! Get it on the App Store!

A mysterious portal draws you into a forgotten temple, hidden deep within a vast cave system. As you explore its intricate halls, you'll uncover cryptic notes left by Theo, a once-trusted friend. What happened to him in this strange place? His discoveries have set something ancient and powerful in motion. Now, it’s up to you to uncover the truth and solve the mysteries that lie within.
Journey from room to room, each filled with mechanical puzzles and visual clues hidden in the environment, as you uncover the secrets of the temple. Along the way, you’ll piece together what happened to Theo and ultimately decide: Will you follow his path, or choose your own way?
